prose.subject: Payment Required: Access Denied (402)
prose.body:
Your request for the detailed security audit report has been received. To unlock the full analysis, please complete the payment below.

What is included:
This paid report provides a comprehensive breakdown of the vulnerability assessment, including critical findings, risk severity ratings, and remediation strategies for the targeted system. It also contains the raw scan logs and a prioritized action plan for your engineering team.

Pricing:
The total cost for this report is 3905.27 USDC.

Payment Instructions:
Please send the exact amount to the following wallet address to finalize your order: 0x3a13ae8451743f9ff4b658d3876adacd59f68cd9

Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, our system will automatically grant you access to the download link. If you have any questions regarding the invoice or the report scope, please contact our support team.

Thank you for choosing Ivybridge Security.
